sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:25

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:25:1
items.html: In the second expansion this lack will be a second time in the nine Sefirot and not in Keter: For in the second expansion too only Keter emerged in the aspect of tastes, as above; but the other nine Sefirot emerged at the time of the refinement in the secret of Nekudot, and that same lack was revealed in them a second time. And therefore the Keter of the second expansion is not alluded to in the four letters of HaVaYaH even in the second expansion, since there is no lack in it. Rather, only from Hochma downward, which are the four levels Hochma, Bina, ZON that emerge on account of the refinement of the screen, as written below, which are called Nekudot, as above — they are alluded to in the Vav of HaVaYaH; and the general departure of this second expansion is the secret of the last Hey of HaVaYaH. And concerning the expansion and the departure of this second expansion, the ARI says above in item 23, “HaVaYaH in all the rest of the Partzufim.” For the two lacks of the first expansion are likewise present in this second expansion, as written before us.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:25:2
items.html:
Nine Sefirot will be called lacking that light, because the light of Keter preceded them. That is to say, that the matter of the lack in them is only with respect to the light of Keter, which preceded them in its superiority, as above — that with respect to it they are counted as reflected light and judgement. However, with respect to themselves they are mercy, since they too are drawn from the Emanator from above downward, as the ARI wrote above (Part 4, Chapter 2, item 1); see there. And it is known that everything drawn from above downward is mercy; only with respect to the light of Keter are they counted as judgement, since their whole emergence is by force of the departure of its light (see in the words of the ARI, Part 4, Chapter 6, and in the Inner Light, item 9; study it there well). However, the two aspects of the general departure — that is, of the first expansion and of the second expansion — which are alluded to in the two letters Hey and Hey of the name HaVaYaH, are a true lack and an aspect of judgement with respect to themselves as well. As the ARI says before us.
What emerges from all the above is that the Yod of HaVaYaH is the secret of the light of the Nekudot of the first expansion — that is, the nine Sefirot from Hochma downward, which emerged there at the time of the departure of the light of the tastes, as above. And the first Hey of the name HaVaYaH is the secret of the general departure of this first expansion. And the Vav of the name HaVaYaH is the secret of the light of the Nekudot of the second expansion, which are the nine Sefirot from Hochma downward, which emerged at the time of the departure of the light of the tastes of this second expansion. And the last Hey of the name HaVaYaH is the secret of the general departure of this second expansion. In such a way that the two expansions of the light of the Nekudot are the secret of Yod and Vav of the name HaVaYaH, and the two departures are the secret of Hey and Hey of the name HaVaYaH.
And this is what he says above in item 23: Yod-Hey in Keter, and HaVaYaH in all the rest of the Partzufim; see there. That is, as explained, that the expansion of the nine Sefirot from Hochma downward, which emerged at the time of the departure of the light of Keter of the first expansion, and the departure of the light of the first expansion in its entirety, are the secret of Yod-Hey of Keter — for the whole first expansion is called by the known name Keter, since it is the Partzuf of Keter of AK. And these two lacks of the light — that is, the aspect of departure with respect to Keter and not with respect to themselves, and the aspect of true departure with respect to themselves as well — are necessarily received also within the second expansion, for all the forces revealed in an upper one are obliged to be found of necessity in the one below it as well. And therefore that Yod-Hey of the first expansion is likewise present in the second expansion; and in addition to them are also those two lacks of the light from its own aspect, which are the aspect of departure with respect to the Keter of the second expansion and not with respect to the nine lower ones themselves, and the aspect of the true general departure of the second expansion, which is the secret of Vav-Hey, as above. Behold that there is here in the second expansion the whole four letters of the name HaVaYaH. And this is what he says, “HaVaYaH in all the rest of the Partzufim” — that is, in the Partzufim of the second expansion.
